title: Vercel Blob now supports TTLs for automatic deletion
description: Vercel Blob can now delete blobs automatically. Pass ttlDays when you write a blob and it is deleted that many days after upload, from 1 to 730 days. The TTL counts from the blob's upload date. Use TTLs for blobs you would otherwise delete yourself, such as session transcripts, exports, and temporary uploads. ttlDays works on put() , copy() , putImage() , multipart uploads, and presigned upload URLs. Every write result and head() response now includes expiresAt , so you know when a blob is due for deletion. setTtl() changes or removes the TTL of blobs you already have, one URL or up to 1,000 at a time, without re-uploading them. In Vercel CLI 65.16.0 and later, pass --ttl-days to vercel blob put , put-image , copy or presign , and use vercel blob set-ttl on existing blobs. Setting a TTL costs one Advanced Operation per started 60 days, on top of the write. A 7-day TTL costs one, and the 730-day maximum costs 13. Clearing a TTL and the deletions themselves are free. You can track TTL operations in the Blob section of the Observability tab. npm install @vercel/blob@2.9.0 Learn more in the Vercel Blob documentation . Read more

title: Pull-request-only preset now available for preview builds
description: A new Ignored Build Step preset lets you skip preview builds for branches without an open pull request. Production deployments and previews for branches with open pull requests continue to build. On GitHub and GitLab projects, skipped preview deployments are canceled before consuming any Build CPU Minutes. To enable this, open your project’s Deployments > Configuration . Under Ignored Build Step , select Only build previews for pull requests from the Behavior menu and click Save . Learn more in the Ignored Build Step documentation . Read more
